content.authorityBasis: Accepted user interview HRR-INTERVIEW-1/2/3 authorizes common/native implementation and real recovery outcome. This engineering source-design decision does not create a user preference or native permission.

decision.legacyV1: Default remains v1 with6000-character cap; no silent budget expansion or weaker semantics.
decision.explicitV2: Source-owned opt-in v2 complete normative delivery cap12000characters, with actual chosen cap/policy version in result/build receipt. Codex Home/global v1 obligations remain; complete v2 cannot drop clauses or original pointers to fit.
decision.common: Canonical shared lossless compact serializer/decoder; no native budget in common core.
decision.overflow: Hold if complete required payload or native metadata cannot fit the explicitly selected cap.

limitations: Source-only policy until exact review/provider closure/current native admission and behavior readback.
Character count is not token/billing accounting.
Manual common-reader consumption, native hook injection and activation remain separate observations.
